data.title: 神尾观铃 · 旧校舍阶梯的黄昏印记
data.description: 放学后的黄昏旧校舍楼梯转角，橙色百褶裙被掀至腰际。观铃一手扶着木制扶手，另一只手按住自己被吻红的嘴唇，在高挑与纤细的交汇处战栗着迎接着极致的充实。
data.location: empty nostalgic wooden schoolhouse staircase landing bathed in fiery dusk
data.action: supported against handrail with orange uniform skirt bunched high, hand pressed to swollen lips, shivering with breathless delight in twilight
data.lighting: intense copper-red sunset beams pouring through tall arched windows
data.mood: nostalgic schoolhouse passion, breathless youthful surrender, unforgettable twilight thrill
data.promptProse: Supported against the wooden staircase banister at sunset, Misuzu pants with hitched skirt as twilight gold bathes her trembling hips.
data.animaCaption: Misuzu supported on the wooden school staircase at dusk, overwhelmed by pleasure.
